title: HuBMAP: Paraffin Embedding Tissue Samples
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bam9ic96

steps.title: Prepare embedding station
steps.instruction: Place processed cassettes in the wax holding chamber of the embedding center and stock the station with embedding utensils, gauze, and disposable embedding molds.

steps.title: Select appropriate mold
steps.instruction: View the tissue sample and choose a disposable embedding mold of suitable size.

steps.title: Partially fill mold with paraffin
steps.instruction: Using forceps, tap the dispenser plate on the embedding center’s dispensing nozzle and partially fill the selected mold with molten paraffin.

steps.title: Transfer tissue into mold
steps.instruction: Using heated forceps, carefully move the tissue from inside the cassette into the mold, positioning the tissue cut side down (the surface seen when opening the cassette).

steps.title: Open cassette and discard lid
steps.instruction: Open the cassette while maintaining tissue orientation and dispose of the cassette lid.

steps.title: Preheat utensils and cold plate
steps.instruction: Preheat embedding utensils in the forceps warming chambers located on the sides of the paraffin dispensing nozzle, and turn on the station’s cold plate module.

steps.title: Press tissue flat on cold pad
steps.instruction: Transfer the mold to the cold pad positioned in front of the dispensing nozzle, then gently press the tissue flat using forceps or a tamper; allow a thin layer of paraffin to solidify to hold the tissue in place.

steps.title: Add cassette basket
steps.instruction: With the tissue centered in the mold, place the lower basket of the emptied cassette on top of the mold.

steps.title: Fill cassette and remove bubbles
steps.instruction: Add additional molten paraffin until the cassette basket is about two‑thirds full, then eliminate any bubbles between the mold and cassette by slowly lifting and repositioning the cassette.

steps.title: Finalize solidification
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the paraffin‑filled mold to the embedding station’s freezing/cold plate module and allow the paraffin to solidify completely.

steps.title: Repeat for additional samples
steps.instruction: If more tissue samples need embedding, return to step 4 and repeat through step 10, then proceed to step 3 to start the next sample.
